display_information.name: Tin
display_information.description: Posts the summaries of your Tin workflows to the channels you pick. Never reads messages.
display_information.long_description: Tin runs marketing for your business as scheduled workflows. Connect this app from Integrations in your Tin project, then choose, for each saved workflow that writes a summary, the Slack channels where it is posted when a run finishes. Tin can list channels and post; it never reads messages. It posts to any public channel, and to a private channel once someone adds the app to it.
